events.text: LOOP CUT round — the microcosm gap. Host session (req_2588-2590, f215df4a9) is FULLY BUILT AND WIRED: popup stepper changes call __mesh_lc_preview (live re-cut from captured base, markDirty repaint), commit journals ONE entry, cancel restores exactly. The user's cuts ARE happening — they are INVISIBLE because new cut edges on a flat-shaded uniform cube draw nothing (gap B face/edge dressing is what makes loop cut unusable — B is structural, not cosmetic). Missing vs old studio treatment: (CC) CUT VISIBILITY — old shows every cut line + per-face center dots instantly during preview; new shows a blank cube (both Image 55/56 look identical at 1-cut-dir0 vs 6-cuts-dir1). (DD) DRAGGABLE CUT GIZMO — old plants the translate gizmo ON the cut plane; dragging it drives the offset live. New offset is popup steppers only; no handle in the viewport. lc_begin already returns size0/size1 so the host knows the cut frame. (EE) SIZE-UNITS OFFSET — old popup has unit toggle [Size Units | Percent], user works in size units (offset 8 = 8u); new popup is hardcoded 'offset %'. The sizes ARE captured in cart state (lc state .sizes from lc_begin) and unused — pure UI. (FF) INSTANT UV — old UV panel re-lays-out live DURING the session (Image 53: 18 faces appear as you cut); new UV atlas panel updates via a manual refresh button ('for the birds') — UV panel must subscribe to topo changes (adoptMesh already knows every re-key).
